title: UI风格#227 - Liquid Glass (液态玻璃)
description: 创建第227种UI风格：液态玻璃风格 - 玻璃拟态、流动质感、透明层次。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planHU.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Liquid Glass style When color palette Then features frosted glass, soft tints, luminous whites
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#E8E8E8 (磨砂白), #D4E4F7 (冰蓝), #F0E6FA (淡紫), #E6FAF0 (薄荷)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Liquid Glass style When typography Then uses clean modern: Inter, DM Sans, Sora
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Inter (清晰), DM Sans (现代), Sora (未来)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Liquid Glass style When layout Then frosted panels, glassmorphism, layered transparency
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：磨砂面板、玻璃拟态、层次透明

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Liquid Glass style When UI elements Then blur effects, refraction, liquid motion
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：模糊效果、折射、液态流动

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Liquid Glass UI When functional Then includes clarity chat, prism agents, clarity stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：清晰聊天、棱镜代理、透明统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Liquid Glass UI When copy Then uses clarity: 'Clear', 'Pure', 'Luminous', 'Refined'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'CLEAR. PURE. LUMINOUS.'、按钮'SUBMIT'→'CLARIFY'、'DEPLOY'→'REFINE'
